inference_seed.pairing: Same prompt_id/run seed in every arm and model; base_seed + run_index

multiplicity: Holm adjustment within each metric family across three arm comparisons
paired_test: two-sided exact McNemar test on discordant cases

interval.method: percentile cluster bootstrap of the treatment-minus-baseline difference

expert_review.agreement: Cohen's kappa and raw agreement before adjudication
expert_review.no_model: Automatic failure; excluded from expert agreement by default
expert_review.adjudication: After independent scoring and agreement calculation

rules: Freeze prompts, source, model, quantization and inference settings before blind runs.
Do not tune prompts, builders, validators or repair on the blind corpus.
Use identical prompt_id/run pairs and the same LLM for all three arms.
Treat repeated runs of one prompt as dependent observations.
Report failures and negative effects; do not redefine thresholds after seeing results.
Development and regression results are not independent confirmatory evidence.
